description: Percentage of scrap parts out of (good + scrap), computed live on the edge over the CURRENT counter values (since-last-reset ratio — IMM counters are cumulative_resettable; windowed truth lives in the oee-hourly continuous aggregate). Full text: docs/history/standard/kpis/scrap-rate.md, description.

calculation.cypher: CASE WHEN (m.part_good + m.part_scrap) = 0 THEN null ELSE round(toFloat(m.part_scrap) / (m.part_good + m.part_scrap) * 1000) / 10 END
